unit.why: A brief anecdote, quoted from an earlier book, about the pre-Hasidic Shelah taking leave of his teacher the Rashal before his wedding and receiving a blessing to keep holiness in eating and in marital relations.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a thematic section 'מענין אכילה' that begins at the end of the previous division and continues as homiletic teaching in the next division.

stories.start_quote: השל"ה היה מתלמידי הרש״ל ולמד אצלו
stories.summary_en: Before his wedding the Shelah, a leading disciple of the Rashal, comes to take leave of his teacher, who blesses him to be careful in the holiness of eating and of marital union, so that light will shine on all his affairs.

tags.why: Laudatory anecdote about pre-Hasidic sages (Rashal, Shelah), taken from an earlier book
Placed in a thematic section on eating as instruction in the holiness of eating and marital relations
